---
title: "repo-familiar"
subtitle: "Agentic engineering dotfiles for repeatable project setup"
---

`repo-familiar` collects reusable instructions, skills, templates, advisory profiles, and documentation practices for AI-assisted software engineering.

The primary product is a project generator for downstream repositories. This repository is the canonical reference source; dotfiles are the metaphor for portable, personal defaults, not the boundary of the implementation.

## What This Site Tracks

- How to use the repository to start new projects.
- Architecture for templates, skills, and generated project assets.
- Documentation conventions for Quarto sites and generated project docs.
- Design decisions and tradeoffs.
- Background research and reference links.
- User stories for the bootstrap workflow.

## Current Status

The first Python generator is implemented with `uv`-first CLI usage, optional `questionary` interaction, the `basic` template, generated Bootstrap Metadata, existing-repository bootstrap, targeted add commands, drift checks, read-only upgrade previews, and skill source provenance checks.

Generated and bootstrapped repositories receive vendored assets by default. Refresh and upgrade behavior remains explicit and preview-first rather than live synchronization.

Use [Bootstrap Lifecycle](./bootstrap-lifecycle.qmd) for the command-safety contract, ownership boundaries, and the profile-family selection matrix.
